plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)

browser.name: OpenVibe Companion
browser.api: https://openvibe.coupons (OpenVibe.Coupons public API), https://openvibe.network (the Dock's state), https://openvibe.chat (the Dock's Chats tab), https://openvibe.codes (the Dock's agent view and its four controls); the agent embed is framed from https://openvibe.live
permissions: sidePanel (Chrome only; Firefox needs no permission for sidebar_action)
browser.credential: optional cpx_ install token (coupons.lookup, coupons.report); the Dock one-click OAuth public client (scopes dock, activity, chat.read; access in storage.session, rotating refresh in storage.local); the 0.7.0 pasted OpenVibe token is still accepted as a fallback until a later release
browser.loadedInChrome: yes: headless Chrome 156 loads the 0.9.2 build via CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked; the side panel's Agents tab draws the Dock's agent view against a stubbed Network/Chat/Codes (the Live stream frame, the task line and meta, and Pause/Resume, Curtain now, Mute/Unmute and End) with its styles applied and no CSP refusal (scripts/check-panel.js); lib/autoapply.js passes three fixture checkout pages in headless Chrome; the one-click Dock sign-in is covered by test/auth.test.js
browser.loadedInFirefox: not yet loaded in a browser; Mozilla's web-ext lint (8.10.0, what AMO runs on upload) passes with 0 errors, 0 warnings and 0 notices, and runs in CI with warnings as errors
handoffs: https://openvibe.reviews/save (a review site's rating, checked and saved on Reviews)
browser.storeBuilds: npm run pack:stores: dist/openvibe-companion-<version>-chrome.zip and -firefox.zip, reproducible, audited
browser.storeListing: store/ (listing, privacy and permission answers, screenshot plan); support URL https://openvibe.coupons/companion
features: OpenVibe Dock one-click sign-in: public OAuth client companion (PKCE S256, no secret), read-only scopes dock/activity/chat.read, access token in storage.session, rotating refresh token in storage.local, Sign out revokes the family, the account page lists it under Signed-in apps

the OpenVibe Dock in the side panel (Chrome side_panel, Firefox sidebar_action): the released OpenVibe.Shared Dock 4.212.0 bundled under browser/shared/ (dock.js, dock-*.js, action-center.js, notification-*.js, agent-sheet.js, agent-session.js, ov-window.js, ov-float.js, ov-composer.js, ov-glyphs.js, brands.js, theme-loader.js, ov-mark.js, kit.css), reading and writing the same Network state as the Dock on a site, with the same tabs (Vibe, Agents, Chats, Activity), and re-reading it every 30 s so the page, the pop-out and the panel agree; the Agents tab draws the person's agent view with Pause/Resume, Curtain now, Mute/Unmute and End, and approvals/sends are hidden with the read-only scopes
pending: owner: create the Chrome Web Store and AMO developer listings and upload the store zips with store/'s answers and screenshots; the Chrome id is fixed by browser/manifest.json key
Firefox: the extension loaded and run in a real Firefox (web-ext lint passes; nothing has run it yet)
use: on 2026-10-22 OpenVibe.Coupons had issued no install token and received no code report; it held 169 codes for 16 of its 37 merchants, all from the DealNews feed through OpenVibe.Sources

Codes/Live credential: the Dock's agent view now asks OpenVibe.Codes with the one-click OAuth token, but Codes' session check refuses the <network>/dock issuer, and Live's embed frame-ancestors allows first-party sites but not an extension origin; the view is bundled and verified against a stub, and needs one of those two to accept the extension before it shows in production
owner: create the Chrome Web Store and AMO developer listings and upload the store zips with store/'s answers and screenshots; the Chrome id is fixed by browser/manifest.json key
Firefox: the extension loaded and run in a real Firefox (web-ext lint passes; nothing has run it yet)

features: OpenVibe Companion (Manifest V3): tries the coupon codes OpenVibe.Coupons knows on a checkout page
keeps a rental listing from any site on the OpenVibe.Rent board with the price, city and bedrooms the page states (read only when pressed), and checks its rent against the city median
watches a page on OpenVibe.Watch, and compares delivery apps on OpenVibe.Food
saves a review site's stated rating to OpenVibe.Reviews (read only when pressed, only on those sites)

an optional cpx_ install token, never an OpenVibe session; and the Dock one-click OAuth sign-in (scopes dock, activity, chat.read; access in storage.session, rotating refresh in storage.local; the 0.7.0 pasted token is still a fallback until a later release)

store-ready: reproducible Chrome and Firefox store zips (npm run pack:stores), listing and privacy answers in store/, Mozilla web-ext lint in CI
